name: Ricotta
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO diets as it's naturally low in lactose due to the cheese-making process that removes most whey.
preparationTips: Choose whole milk ricotta for better texture and flavor
Drain excess whey if using for baking to prevent soggy results
Can be used fresh or incorporated into cooked dishes
Store covered in refrigerator and use within 3-5 days of opening
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of calcium for bone health
Lower in sodium than many other cheeses
